Name: AraCosmetic
Description: Arabic Facebook corpus of cosmetic discourse.
Paper Title: AraCosmetic: Building and Analysing an Arabic Facebook Corpus of Cosmetic Discourse
Abstract: We introduce AraCosmetic, a domain-refined Arabic Facebook corpus containing 116,132 posts published by 16,141 public pages between September 2021 and August 2024. The corpus was constructed through a two-stage pipeline. Posts were first collected using the polysemous seed term “زيفحت” and then filtered with a cosmetic-domain lexicon that distinguishes cosmetic-related “stimulation” from off-domain motivational uses. This process retained 42.1% of the original collection. Descriptive analyses show highly concentrated engagement. Posts containing one to three hashtags have a modest 2.4% mean-engagement advantage over posts without hashtags, while posts combining a URL with video have a 212.4% advantage. The relationship between post length and hashtag use varies across the corpus. The corpus is available upon request to support future research on advertising-claim detection, body-image discourse analysis, and consumer-protection NLP.
